title: Your updated Courtside
label: A QUICK TOUR
bullets: Layouts built for phones and tablets
text: Here is a quick tour of your updated Courtside interface. The goal was to make it feel professional and easier to use on a phone. These screens use sample sessions, so the measurements are illustrations.

title: A clearer workspace
label: DESKTOP DESIGN
bullets: Five main pages in the sidebar
Settings and release checks grouped below
text: First, the desktop layout has a consistent green and warm white theme, clearer headings, and a simpler sidebar. The main pages are Live Court, Overview, Session Library, My Progress, and Coaching Notes. Settings and release checks sit in the workspace section.

title: Your library on a phone
label: MOBILE LIBRARY
bullets: Workspace selector gets its own row
List status sits below the session title
text: On a phone, the header gives the workspace selector its own row. Page names stay readable, and buttons have more room to tap. The session library lets you search, filter by type or status, and switch between cards and a compact list. In list view, the status sits below each session title.

title: Set up before you play
label: LIVE COURT
bullets: Permission and junior fields stay together
The camera remains off until you start
text: Live Court puts the camera preview first and the setup panel below it. Choose a camera and confirm processing permission before starting. If a junior is present, guardian consent and player agreement are also required. The camera stays off until you start the feed.

title: Review one shot at a time
label: SESSION REPORTS
bullets: Choose a shot before reviewing its clip
text: Open a session to review individual shots. On a phone, the shot picker comes before the selected shot. All shot filters remain visible, and the list scrolls within its panel. The report then shows the clip, technique measurements, and coaching observations.

title: Readable charts and forms
label: PROGRESS & UPLOAD
bullets: Chart labels keep a readable size
Dialog close buttons stay within reach
text: My Progress compares your sessions over time. The chart adapts to the screen width while keeping its labels readable. Upload dialogs also fit the phone screen, and their close button stays visible while you scroll.

title: Ready to explore
label: NAVIGATION & CHECKS
text: Finally, the menu works on both portrait and short landscape screens. The main pages were checked on phone and tablet sizes, and all twenty six frontend tests passed. Start in the session library to explore the examples, or open Live Court when you are ready to set up a session.
